title: WizeMe.APP | Private AI Continuity and Decision OS
excerpt: The private AI thinking partner that turns scattered conversations, meetings, notes, goals, people, and open loops into continuity, better decisions, and practical follow-through.
content_html:
Private continuity for people carrying too much context

Stop losing the thread. WizeMe remembers what matters so you move.

One private partner turns scattered apps, meetings, notes, relationships, and open loops into clearer decisions and follow-through.

Private by design — your memory stays yours Published, reproducible benchmarks Nothing sent without your approval

Secure, account-scoped permission controls stay visible at every connection and action boundary.

One thread. Three clean stages.

Bring — Start with one real thread

A decision, meeting, person, note, habit, or open loop.

Build — Create useful continuity

Your partner connects approved context, evidence, and what changed.

Move — Leave with a next action

Turn understanding into a brief, rehearsal, reminder, or clear move.

Bring approved context without losing its source.

Bring approved context from Gmail, Calendar, Notion, Granola, Plaud, CRM files, notes, and more. WizeMe keeps connected sources permissioned and source-labeled.

Built for people whose context is already too valuable to keep scattered.

Founders, operators, professionals, creators, students, caregivers, and ambitious people can use WizeMe to connect work, family, health, goals, notes, relationships, and decisions. It is not a replacement for human judgment. It is a continuity layer that helps you notice what matters sooner and act with less re-explaining.

Trust starts with boundaries.

WizeMe should say when evidence is not loaded, keep connected sources permissioned and source-labeled, and avoid pretending certainty from a cold start. Public benchmark artifacts and docs are published separately from private product internals so claims can be checked without exposing user data, source code, training corpora, API keys, environment files, or internal secrets.

content_html_zh:
为携带太多背景信息的人提供私人连续性

别再丢线了。 WizeMe 会记住重要的事情，以便您移动。

一位私人合作伙伴将分散的应用程序、会议、笔记、关系和开放循环转变为更清晰的决策和后续行动。

设计上的私密性 — 您的记忆归您所有 已发布、可重现的基准 未经您的批准，不会发送任何内容

安全的、帐户范围的权限控制在每个连接和操作边界上保持可见。

一根线。 三个干净的阶段。

Bring——从一个真实的线程开始

决定、会议、人、笔记、习惯或开环。

构建——创造有用的连续性

您的合作伙伴将已批准的背景、证据和发生的变化联系起来。

移动 — 离开并进行下一步操作

将理解变成简短的、排练的、提醒的或清晰的动作。

带来经过批准的背景而不丢失其来源。

从 Gmail、日历、Notion、Granola、Plaud、CRM 文件、笔记等中获取经过批准的上下文。 WizeMe 保持连接源的许可和源标签。

专为那些背景已经太有价值而不能分散的人们而设计。

创始人、运营商、专业人士、创作者、学生、护理人员和雄心勃勃的人可以使用 WizeMe 连接工作、家庭、健康、目标、笔记、关系和决策。 它不能替代人类判断。 它是一个连续性层，可以帮助您更快地注意到重要的事情，并在无需重新解释的情况下采取行动。

信任始于界限。

WizeMe 应该在未加载证据时发出提示，保持连接源的许可和源标签，并避免从冷启动就假装确定。 公共基准工件和文档与私有产品内部分开发布，因此可以在不暴露用户数据、源代码、训练语料库、API 密钥、环境文件或内部机密的情况下检查声明。
